Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the role... As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers: Two Accounting Partnerships Managers One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex. This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships. The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities. The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office. What you’ll do... Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM. Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team. Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers. Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical. Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC. Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos. Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities. Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution. Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not. Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey. What you’ll bring... 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role. A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes. Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue. Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital. A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers. Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships. Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management. Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential. Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment. Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required. Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases. Who you are... Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details. Channel-led: you care about net-new business and revenue, not only signed agreements or ecosystem visibility. A builder: you create structure from zero, test quickly and learn without waiting for a perfect playbook. Commercially accountable: you use data to decide where to invest, coach or stop. A player-coach: you develop people while continuing to win strategic partnerships yourself. What success looks like... Accounting and Travel & E-commerce have prioritised partner strategies and active channel motions in France and Spain. Partner cohorts are recruited, activated and connected to repeatable referral, reseller or co-selling motions. The team scales the highest-performing partner segments and quickly deprioritises inactive or low-potential relationships. Why join Airwallex... description: About Sidetrade: Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific. We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.  Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion : Aimie Video Requirements Today, we're looking for our Global VP of Talent Acquisition to build and lead our Ai-native shift and create the dream team for our next stage of growth. This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership challenge for designing a scalable, data-driven talent acquisition function across all regions in the world (North America, Europe, and APAC), all functions and levels -from AI expert to GTM and from Mid-level to Executives. You'll partner directly with the executive team and hiring managers to ensure we attract, hire, and onboard the talent needed to hit our growth targets, while building a TA function that's efficient, candidate-centric, and built for scale. Because it’s instrumental to the strategy, this role will report directly to the CEO. What you would do: Strategy & Leadership: Define and own the global talent acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with headcount budgets, business goals, and workforce planning across all regions. Team Management: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global TA team, including regional leads, recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators; set goals, coach performance, and grow internal talent. Executive & Leadership Hiring: Personally in charge of hiring senior C-level roles with the CEO. Process & Scale: Design and continuously improve AI Agents for recruiting processes, workflows, and SLAs to ensure a consistent, efficient, and high-quality hiring experience. Employer Brand: Own the company's employer brand and candidate value proposition globally; partner with Marketing and Comms to strengthen our reputation as an employer of choice . Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. 🤖 Who we are Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone. We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . The Clinic is two crews building one experience: Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥. 🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them. The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own: 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own. ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well. 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions. 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out. If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently. ⚡ Why this role is special Dual impact : Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products Leadership growth : Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach. Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health. 🔍 What we're looking for We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare. Leadership experience 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers. You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver. Technical foundations Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions. First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus. You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself. Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools. What we value Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow. You develop people as much as you develop products. Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team. Mission alignment Healthcare technology and innovation excite you You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you . Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
